# Stage-5/6 headless validation entry point.
# The small plan file below is generated by scripts/04_generate_topas_plan.py
# from the same spots.csv as the current complete plan.
includeFile = beam/plan_validation_generated.txt

# This stage validates parameter parsing, sequential spot changes, carbon-ion
# identity, total kinetic energy and transverse coordinates. Transport physics
# and dose scoring are intentionally deferred to the next stage.
sv:Ph/Default/Modules = 1 "Transportation_Only"

# A thin vacuum plane 10 mm downstream of the source records the generated
# primary phase space without touching the patient or introducing dose.
s:Ge/PlanValidationMinusX/Type = "TsBox"
s:Ge/PlanValidationMinusX/Parent = "World"
s:Ge/PlanValidationMinusX/Material = "Vacuum"
d:Ge/PlanValidationMinusX/HLX = 0.05 mm
d:Ge/PlanValidationMinusX/HLY = 100. mm
d:Ge/PlanValidationMinusX/HLZ = 100. mm
d:Ge/PlanValidationMinusX/TransX = 290. mm
d:Ge/PlanValidationMinusX/TransY = 0. mm
d:Ge/PlanValidationMinusX/TransZ = 0. mm

s:Ge/PlanValidationPlusX/Type = "TsBox"
s:Ge/PlanValidationPlusX/Parent = "World"
s:Ge/PlanValidationPlusX/Material = "Vacuum"
d:Ge/PlanValidationPlusX/HLX = 0.05 mm
d:Ge/PlanValidationPlusX/HLY = 100. mm
d:Ge/PlanValidationPlusX/HLZ = 100. mm
d:Ge/PlanValidationPlusX/TransX = 310. mm
d:Ge/PlanValidationPlusX/TransY = 0. mm
d:Ge/PlanValidationPlusX/TransZ = 0. mm

s:Sc/PlanValidationPhaseSpace/Quantity = "PhaseSpace"
s:Sc/PlanValidationPhaseSpace/Surface = "PlanValidationMinusX/XPlusSurface"
s:Sc/PlanValidationPhaseSpace/OutputType = "ASCII"
s:Sc/PlanValidationPhaseSpace/OutputFile = "../topas_output/test/plan_validation_phase_space"
s:Sc/PlanValidationPhaseSpace/IfOutputFileAlreadyExists = "Overwrite"
b:Sc/PlanValidationPhaseSpace/OutputToConsole = "False"
b:Sc/PlanValidationPhaseSpace/IncludeRunID = "True"
b:Sc/PlanValidationPhaseSpace/IncludeEventID = "True"

s:Sc/PlanValidationReversePhaseSpace/Quantity = "PhaseSpace"
s:Sc/PlanValidationReversePhaseSpace/Surface = "PlanValidationPlusX/XMinusSurface"
s:Sc/PlanValidationReversePhaseSpace/OutputType = "ASCII"
s:Sc/PlanValidationReversePhaseSpace/OutputFile = "../topas_output/test/plan_validation_reverse_phase_space"
s:Sc/PlanValidationReversePhaseSpace/IfOutputFileAlreadyExists = "Overwrite"
b:Sc/PlanValidationReversePhaseSpace/OutputToConsole = "False"
b:Sc/PlanValidationReversePhaseSpace/IncludeRunID = "True"
b:Sc/PlanValidationReversePhaseSpace/IncludeEventID = "True"

i:Ge/CheckForOverlapsResolution = 1000
b:Ge/CheckForOverlaps = "True"
b:Ge/QuitIfOverlapDetected = "True"
i:Ts/NumberOfThreads = 1
i:Ts/ShowHistoryCountAtInterval = 1000
b:Ts/PauseBeforeQuit = "False"
